## We’re one of the fastest-growing conversational AI scale-ups

Founded in 2018 by a team of experienced software engineers and business consultants, Druid AI has proved to be one of the most successful conversational AI-focused global providers.

![](https://www.druidai.com/hubfs/award-03.svg)

##### Deloitte Technology Fast 50

DRUID won the Growth Stars category for the fastest growth, in Deloitte's competition.

![](https://www.druidai.com/hubfs/award-02.svg)

##### Startup of the Year

DRUID won several Startup of the Year awards in regional and global competitions.

![](https://www.druidai.com/hubfs/award-04.svg)

##### Best AI Solution

DRUID won the conversational AI competition at the Chatbot Summit in Berlin.

![](https://www.druidai.com/hubfs/award-05.svg)

##### Best RPA Connector

Awarded by a panel of senior executives from GE, ExxonMobil, Orange, and Optum.
